Drives motorized equipment: Yes
0-1 years of related experience
Experience working directly with TRIO or similar outreach/support program.

Under close supervision of higher-level professional: Provides straightforward information about department major requirements. - Provides general information about campus resources and campus navigational strategies. In coordination with the TRIO Director and Assistant Directors, works with other departments on campus (Financial Aid, Basic Needs, Academic Resource Center, Career Center, the Well, etc.) in providing information of services for participants (30% time)

Enters student data into department/school/college student systems. Retrieves and inputs confidential student data into department student database. - Under close supervision of the TRIO Scholars Assistant Director and McNair Scholars Assistant Director, assists with data compilation, creation of student files, and documentation of services in compliance with federal regulations. (25% time)

Assists higher level professionals in preparing admissions materials for review. - Support TRIO Scholars Assistant Director and McNair Scholars Assistant Director by ensuring program applications are complete. Assists in the recruitment, screening, and selection processes of applicants for the program. (25% time)
Communicates with students on a regular basis in-person, telephone, mail, and e-mail to assist with the facilitation of retention activities. (10% time)
Responsible for assisting the TRIO Director and PI in meeting grant objectives as set forth in the Student Support Services and McNair Scholars approved grants. (5% time)
Other duties as assigned. (5% time)
